records.title: Self sufficiency in power
details:
It was inter alia stated that Planning Commission had fixed a capacity addition target of 78,700 MW during 11th Plan period to meet the power requirement of the country. Central Electricity Authority 
(CEA) has recently reviewed the likely capacity addition during 11th Plan after meeting with project developers. Based on the inputs provided by the project developers and suppliers, CEA has assessed that a total capacity of 62,374 MW is likely to be commissioned with high level of certainty during the 11th Plan, out of which projects aggregating 18,859 MW have already been commissioned till 30.11.2009. In addition, projects aggregating 12,590 MW are being attempted for commissioning on best efforts basis. 
A capacity addition of at least 1,00,000 MW would be required by the 12th Plan to meet the projected demand. The capacity addition programme for the 12th Plan is yet to be finalized.

records.title: Indians travelling with false documents
details: Information on steps being taken within the country to prevent illegal migration, including through co-operation of NGOs, is being collected from the concerned Ministries/Departments and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: audit of remaining 138 districts under NREGS
details: It was inter alia stated that on the request of the Ministry of Rural Development CAG submitted its draft report on performance audit of the implementaion of NREGA in phase 1 distts for the year 2006-07 on 17-12-2007 to the Ministry. The draft report has been examined and shared with all the states. The States have given their responses to the observation made by the CAG in the draft report. These responses have been sent to CAG. The state responses are in the process of the examination by CAG for finalization of the perofrmance audit report of NREGA.

records.title: Application of RTI Act on Supreme Court
details: The position of Application of Right to Information Act on Supreme Counrt is being ascertained for examination in the Government.

records.title: Inclusion of Rajasthani Language in the Eighth Schedule
details: The matter of inclusion of Rajasthani language in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution is under examination

records.title: e-Commerce Policy
details: Wide consultations were held on the draft Personal Data Protection Bill and open feedback was invited on the contents of the bill. These are currently being processed and it is proposed to table the bill in Parliament.

records.title: retirement age of judges
details: It was inter alia stated that a proposal to increase the retirement age of the judges of the SC and the HC by three years is under examination of the Govt. As regards increase in th retirement age of Distt/Subordinate Court judges, it is the concern of the respective State Govts.
